description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuluwa, Galle - Four Gravets, D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and owner details). The content focuses on land ownership registration, title determinations, and property rights - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
